question: List the names of singers who performed in a concert with the theme Free choice.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.Name FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice'
candidate_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name
FROM singer AS s
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON s.Singer_ID = TRY_CAST(sic.Singer_ID AS BIGINT)
JOIN concert AS c
  ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice';
